overview.html:
AI Tutor Overview

The AI Tutor is 4Eye's flagship personalized learning system. It adapts to each student's learning style, pace, and knowledge gaps to provide one-on-one instruction that rivals human tutoring.

🎯 Key Value Proposition

Every student gets a personal tutor that never gets tired, never judges, and adapts in real-time to how they learn best.

Core Capabilities

  • Adaptive Learning Paths - Dynamically adjusts difficulty and content based on student performance
  • Multi-Modal Instruction - Text, audio, visual, and interactive explanations
  • Real-Time Feedback - Instant, encouraging feedback that guides without giving answers
  • Knowledge Gap Detection - Identifies and fills gaps in understanding
  • Learning Style Recognition - Adapts to visual, auditory, reading/writing, or kinesthetic preferences
